description: Yesu yahavuye aja kuzimanwa n’umufarisayo ahasigirwa amavuta n’umugore wunyavyaha, nawe aca aharirwa ivyaha vyiwe. Yesu yaciye akomeza ibikorwa vyiwe mubisagara bitandukanye akiza abantu ingwara zabo nabo baca baramukurikira. Yahavuye abacira umugani w’umubivyi agomba kubereka ingene ijambo ry’Imana avuga ryakirwa n’abantu batandukanye n’ingene barigaragaza.
name: -Ivyabaye kuri Yesu igihe yagendera umufarisayo, Inyigisho ku migani ibiri yesu yaciriye ishengero, n’ibitangaza bibiri yakoze.

description: Bajana Yesu mu rusengero ngo akebwe, bahahuriye na Simeyoni na Ana bose bashima Imana ku bw’uyo. Simeyoni yari yarasezeraniwe ko atazopfa atabonye agakiza Imana yari yateguriye amahanga. Yesu ni we yazanye agakiza, umwakiriye aba yakiriye agakiza Imana itanga. Yesu asigara I yelusalemu aganira n’abigisha. Imbere yuko Yesu atangura ibikorwa, Yohani ni we yabanje kumwitangira imbere yigisha ukubatizwa kwo kwihana ngo baharirwe ivyaha.
name: #NAME?

description: Yesu ashitse i Yerusalemu yanyinyuranye n’ibibazo vy’imitego vy’abafarisayo, abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe hamwe n’abasadukayo. Yaravuze amajambo y’ubuhanuzi kuvyo guhona kw’i Yerusalemu n’ibizoba mu gihe c’iherezo.
name: Amajambo Yesu yabwiye abariko bamugeza n’ubuhanuzi kuri Yerusalemu.

description: Yesu yari yatanguye urugendo rwo kuja I Yelusalemu kandi ni ho yabambiwe. Akiri mu nzira yabwiye abantu ko bakwiye kubandanya baca mw’irembo ripfunganye, bakirinda no kwanjanjwa ku butumire batumirirwa ku buntu.
name: Gukurikira Yesu no kwihana ivyaha.

description: Umucamanza yahavuye atunganiriza uwo mupfakazi kuko yashishikaye aja kugora umucamanza. Yesu rero ati none mbeg’Imana ntizocira abo yatoranije urubanza rubakiza bayiborogera ku murango no mw’ijoro.Ariko kandi iyo umuntu asenga akwiye guca bugufi kuko tubibona muri uno mugani w’umutozakori n’umufarisayo. Hano kandi turabona umusore w’umutunzi afise ingorane mu mutima kuko ubutunzi bwiwe bumubuza gukurikira Yesu. Yesu yahavuye yerekana ikibanza c’abana mu kubahezagira, hanyuma akora igitangaza co gukiza impumyi.
name: Gushishikara gusenga ntiturambirwe kandi twicisha bugufi.

description: Umugabisha w’abasoda ijana yerekanye ukwizera kwiwe mukwereka Yesu k’umushumba wiwe yokira atanarinze gushika mu nzu yiwe. Yesu atangarira ukwo kwizera. Yabandanije akora ibitangaza mukuzura umuhungu w’umupfakazi amuteye akagongwe. Yohani umubatizi yumvise ivya Yesu amutumako ngo bamubaze ko ari we Kristo. Yesu amwishurisha ibitangaza aca amushingira intahe ko mubavyawe n’abagore atawumuruta.
name: Ibitangaza Yesu yakoze n’ingene yashingiye intahe Yohani umubatizi.

description: Yesu yakijije umuntu yari yinjiwemwo n’abadayimoni benshi, abahindira mu ngurube zica zisuka mu kiyaga. Abavyumvise baca baramwinginga ngo ave iwabo kuko bari batinye. Mwumve namwe ubwo buhombe bwo kwirukana umukiza. Yesu yabandanije akora ibitangaza akiza abagwaye yongera azura abapfuye.
name: Inkuru y’umuntu yinjiwemwo n’abadayimoni, hamwe n’ibindi bitangaza Yesu yakoze, Yesu amenyesha abigishwa ko agiye gupfa kandi ko azozuka.

description: Yohana Umubatizi yavuze ubutumwa bwo kwihana abubwira abaje kubatizwa. Yohana yavuga ubutumwa ataboboteza gushika n’aho abuzira. Ariko rero Yagiye mwibohero ahejeje kubatiza Yesu kandi ijuru ryarashingiye intahe igikorwa ca Yohana umubatizi.
name: Inkuru za Yohani umubatizi hamwe n’ingene Yesu yatanguye igikorwa cari camuzanye.

description: Abafarisayo babajije Yesu aho abwami bw’Imana buzozira aca abwira ko buri hagati muri bo kuko Yesu yar’aho. Yaciye abagabisha ko atawobahenda ababwira ngo ubwami bw’Imana buzoza umusi munaka. Umuntu akwiye kwama agavye kuko atawuzi umusi n’Isaha. Yaciye ababwira ko umuntu asenga kw’akwiye gusenga ntarambirwe.
name: Ivy’ubwami bw’Imana n’ukugaruka kwa Kristo.

description: Yesu yageragejwe na satani afatiye kubintu abantu bahahamira, ariko Yesu yaranesheje kubera yari yuzuye Mpwemu Yera akagira n’ijambo ry’Imana. Ahejeje kugeragezwa na satani yaciye atangura kwigisha ahereye mu gisagara c’iwabo. Ariko aho I wabo ntibamwakiriye. Yahavuye yigira mu gahinga ishengero ryinshi riramukurikira benshi bakizwa ingwara bari bafise.
name: Ivy’ukugeragezwa n’ibikorwa vyakurikiye

description: Yesu yinjire i Yerusalemu ari ku nyana y’ indogoba, abantu nabo basemerera bahimbaza Imana. Ivyo vyerekana ko Yesu ari umwami ahambaye. Ashitseyo yaririye Yerusalemu. Ashitse mu rusengero yahumanuye urusengero mu kwirukana abadandariza muri rwo. Ico gihe abaherezi bakuru bamubaza iyo akura ububasha bumukoresha nawe abishurisha ikibazo baca baratiya kucishura. Baca babandanya bamurondera hasi kubura hejuru aho bamugeresha ivy’ikori. Aca abavuga ko mu kubacira umugani w’abarimyi b’abagarariji.
name: Ivyabaye igihe Yesu yashika i Yerusalemu, abarimyi b’abagarariji, Ibibazo abaherezi bakuru babjije Yesu.

description: Ivuka rya Yohani umubatizi rimaze kumenyekana baciye babwirwa ibizomuranga. Zakariya ntiyashotse avyizera maze aca aronka igihano co kugobwa ururimi. Ntivyatevye Umumalayika yaciye yongera kumenyesha Mariya ko azovyara Yesu. Ivyo vyaramutangaje kuko Atari azi icitwa umugabo, ariko yashimye ubugombe bw’Imana. Ku Mana ntakidashoboka.
name: Ivyabaye kuri Zakariya, Mariya amenya ko azovyara Yesu

description: Imana yitwararika ibiguruka ntiyoreka kwitwararika abayikorera. N’ukubaha ubwami biramuhimbara. Kimwe gusa twame tugavye, tuwmamire ivyamwa. Yagereranije ubwami bw’Imana n’akabuto ka sinapi bo n’umwambiro. Munyuma yinjira mw’isinagogi kwigisha aca ahakiriza umugore yari ahetamye ariko abafarisayo ntivyabahimbaye na cane cane ko hari kw’isabato.
name: Ivyo kwihana n’ukwama twiteguye.

description: Yesu yaduganye na Petero, Yohana na Yakobo baduga umusozi gusenga, Yesu ahiduka ukundi, arakayangana, Imana imushingira intahe kwari umwana W’Imana. Avuye kuri uwo musozi yaciye akiza uwari agwaye intandara kandi abigishwa bari bananiwe. Abantu bahimbaza Imana. Yesu yaciye abandanya yigisha abigishwa ababwira ivy’urupfu rwiwe.
name: Ugukayangana kwa Yesu, Igitangaza yakoreye umuhungu yar’agwaye intandara, hamwe n’izindi nyigisho Yesu yahaye abigishwa biwe

description: Pilato amaze gutanga Yesu, bafata Simoni umunyakureni ngo amutwaze umusaraba. Abantu benshi baramukurikira bamuririra, ariko Yesu arababwira ati ni mwiririre mwebwe n’abana banyu. Amaze kubambwa hagati y’ibisuma bibiri umwe muribo asaba imbabazi uwundi aramutuka. Urupfu rwa Yesu rwatumye haba ubwira kabiri, igihuzu gikingiriye ahera hahera gitandamuka mwo kubiri. Umugabisha w’ingabo ati n’ukuri uyu yari umugororotsi. Munyuma baja kuhamba Yesu mw’iteka ryinshi.
name: Ukubambwa kwa Yesu n’urupfu rwiwe.

description: Elizabeti avyaye Yohana ababanyi babo banezeranwe na bo, bamwita izina ryavuzwe n’umumalayika. Akanwa ka Zakariya karazibuka atazira Imana kubibaye. Haciye imisi nk’amezi atandatu, Yesu aravuka, akebwa ku musi ugira umunani nk’uko ivyagezwe vyari
name: Ukuvuka kwa Yohana Umubatizi n’ukuvuka kwa Yesu Kristo

description: Yesu ashitse i Yeriko akurikiwe n’abantu benshi, abantu baguma bagomba kumubona. Muri bo harimwo Zakayo ari nawe yahavuye akizwa Yesu amaze kuja kurara iwe naho abantu babibona bidodomvye ngo arariye umuntu w’umunyavyaha. Ariko icazanye Yesu kwari ukurondera no gukiza icazimiye. Munyuma yabaciriye umugani abereka uwizigirwa kuri bike azokwizigirwa no kuri vyinshi.
name: Ukwihana kwa Zakayo n’ingene Yesu azohemba abo yasigaranye ibikorwa.

description: Abafarisayo bagirije Yesu n’abigishwa biwe ko bariko barenga isabato mukumyoza ingano, nawe aca aboneraho kubigisha abereka ko ari umwami w’isabato, aca ababuza gudaca imanza kuko umucamanza ari umwe ni Imana izi vyose. Ac’arabereka abahirwe abo ari bo.
name: Ukwubaka kurutare aryo Yesu kugira ngw’ibikorwa vyacu ntibibe ivy’impfagusa

description: Hano Yesu yigishije yuko atawodomeka itara ngo arishire mu mwobo, kandi ko itara ry’umuntu ari ijisho ryiwe. Yaraseruye ivyaha vy’abafarisayo n’abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe, twarabonye kandi umugani w’umutunzi w’igipfu, yarongeye arihaniza abigishwa biwe kwiganyira.
name: Umugani w’itara ryaka.

description: Muri kino cirwa Yesu yabanje kubereka ko kwahukana kutabereye. Mu mugani w’umutunzi n’umworo Yesu yavuze ivy’inyuma y’urupfu yerekana ko umuntu azoronka ibikwiranye n’ivyo yakoze akiri muzima. Munyuma yibukije abantu guhanurana no guharirana.Bakiri mu nzira, akiza abanyamibembe 10, ariko hagaruka gushima umwe gusa.
name: Umugani w’umutunzi n’umworo.

description: Yesu yaciriye imigani abafarisayo n’abanyabwenge b’ivyanditswe bari bamurembeje ngo yiyegereje abatozakori n’abanyavyaha. Yabaciriye umugani w’intama n’ihera vyazimiye kugira abereke ko mu bwami bwiwe ata wo guhebwa arimwo. Yongera abacira umugani w’umwana yagararije se kugira abereke ko kuva mu Mana atamugisha urimwo.
name: Umwana w’icangazi

description: Muri buno butumwa bwiza bwa Luka, yabanje kwerekana ko ivyo yanditse atagukekeranya, ko umuntu abisoma akwiye kuvyizera. Turabona kandi ko Imana yashingiye intahe ukuvuka kwa Yohana umubatizi. Aha kandi turabona ko Imana yashikije isezerano kuri Zakariya na Elisabeti mukubaha umwana kuko bari ingumba kandi bashitse muza bukuru, ariko kandi bari abagororotsi. Nawewe shishikara ukugororoka kwawe Imana nayo yiteguye kugushitsako ivyo yagusezeraniye.
name: Uruhara rw’ubutumwa bwiza bwa Luka kubo yandikiye.

description: Aha tubona ukuntu Yesu yahamagaye intumwa zimwe zimwe n’ingene yakijije umunyamibembe n’ikimuga. Mu mpera yiki gice ca gatanu yesu yigishije ivyerekeye kwisonzesha.
name: Yesu ahamagara intumwa zimwe zimwe, n’ibitangaza yakoze vyo gukiza

description: Yesu yabandanije avuga ku vy’uguhona kw’i Yerusalemu n’ivyago bizoshikira abazoguma mur’ico gisagara. Yaravuze n’ibimenyetso bizoboneka ku kwezi no kuzuba. Pasika yari yegereje Yesu aca atanguza ingaburo Yera, Yuda nawe arondera ingene yogura umwami wiwe.Birababaje.
name: Yesu asangira n’abigishwa biwe ivya Pasika, aca atanguza ingaburo Yera.

description: Yesu rero yaciye atangura kubabwira ko muribo hari ugira amugure, ariko ko azobona ibara. Aho Yesu yariko yiyumvira ivy’urupfu rwiwe, abigishwa bo bariko baniganira ubukuru. Ariko yarababwiye ko umukuru ari ukorera abandi. Yesu Yaciye abwira Petero imigambi ya satani, at’ariko wewe nagusengeye ngo ukwizera kwawe ntiguhere. Yahavuye aja gusengera igetsemane aho yabonye ibidasanzwe, Malayika amwongerwa inkomezi aca yakira abugombe bw’Imana, abazanywe na Yuda baca barashika baramufata.
name: Yesu asezera abigishwa biwe abaremesha, Yuda azana igitero c’abaje gufata Yesu.

description: Yesu yatumye abigishwa 70 atuma babiri babiri baja kwigisha. Yarababwiye ingene bakwiye kwifata. Bagarukanye umunezero babwira Yesu uko vyagenze. Nawe abonye ipfuhe rya Satani aca abaha ububasha, ababwira kunezerererwa ko amazina yabo yanditswe mu gitabo c’ubugingo. Munyuma Yesu yishura ikibazo yari abajijwe cico umuntu yokora ngo ararwe ubugingo budashira, aca amwishura afatiye kuvyagezwe.
name: Yesu atuma abigishwa kwigisha, Umugani w’umusamaliya w’imbabazi

description: Bamaze gufata Yesu, bamujanye, Petero aramukurikira barenga arenguka. Bamaze gushika mu rugo rw’umuherezi mukuru niho yagiriye ingorane zo kwihakana Yesu. Mu nyuma baramushinyagurira, baramutonagura, barondera inyanduruko yo kumwagiriza. Muri iryo joro bamujana kwa Pilato no kwa Herode ariko bose ntacaha bamubonyeko. Ariko pilato na Herode baca baruzura kuva ico gihe. Pilato ntivyamukundiye kurekura Yesu kubw’ishengero. N’uko babamba Yesu barekura umwicanyi Baraba.
name: Yesu bamukubita, bakamushinyagurira barahava bamucira urubanza rwo gupfa.

description: Yesu ahejeje gusenga abigishwa baca bamusaba ngo abigishe gusenga. Yaciye abigisha isengesho rya Data wa twese. Mu nyuma yaciye asenda amudayimoni atera uburagi, ishengero riratangara ariko bashira ivyo bikorwa vya Mpwemu Yera kuri Satani. Hanyuma Yesu arangiza atanga ikimenyetso kizotsindisha abanka kwizera ijambo ry’Imana ngo bihane ari co ca Yona.
name: Yesu yigisha abigishwa biwe gusenga, abantu bashira kuri satani ibikorwa vya Mpwemu Yera, ikimenyetso ca Yona.

description: Umwana w’icangazi yahavuye yisubiramwo agaruka kwa Se kandi Se yamwakiranye urukundo. Uko uwo yononye itunga ryiwe niko n’abazezwa ivy’abandi bashobora ku vyonona nkuko tubibona kuri uyu mubwiriza. Aha rero tumenye ko uwizigigwa kuri bike azozezwa na vyinshi.
name: Yesu yihanikiriza abizera bose ngo ntibaganzwe n’itunga ribi.
